part.text:
Fixed. The bug was in `packages/babel-helpers/src/index.ts` (`permuteHelperAST`): when a helper's exported function name (e.g. `_set`) collides with the helper entry-point id generated by `addHelper`, the helper's internal function (`set`) was renamed to `_set`, producing two same-named declarations where `_set` recursively called itself.

The fix (matching upstream commit f8fcf77139) reserves the target id name when computing renames — packages/babel-helpers/src/index.ts:259:

```ts
const bindings = new Set(localBindings || []);
if (id.type === "Identifier") bindings.add(id.name);
```

Now `set` → `__set` and the exported `_set` is kept, so `super.bar = 1` compiles correctly for both `transform-classes` and `transform-object-super`.

Verified in the container (after rebuilding `babel-helpers/lib`):
- `yarn jest packages/babel-helpers/test` — 12 passed (includes the `declaration name conflict helper entrypoint` regression test)
- `packages/babel-plugin-transform-classes` + `transform-object-super` — 223 passed
- `packages/babel-core` — 442 passed
- `transform-runtime` + `proposal-object-rest-spread` — 79 passed

Only `packages/babel-helpers/src/index.ts` is modified (built `lib/` artifacts are gitignored).
